profile.headline: Software Engineer in Test SDET II | Playwright + TypeScript + Javascript | AI-Assisted Test Automation | CI/CD | Quality Engineering | Automation of API, Mobile & Web | BrowserStack | Driving Scalable Test Solutions
profile.summary:
I’m an SDET passionate about building scalable automation, improving engineering velocity, and delivering high‑quality software at speed. I specialize in creating robust automation frameworks, optimizing CI/CD test pipelines, and partnering with developers to ship reliable, user‑focused products.
I thrive in fast‑paced engineering environments where curiosity, ownership, and continuous improvement drive every decision. I love solving complex problems, simplifying systems, and designing tests that uncover what others might miss.
Strengths: automation architecture, API/UI testing, CI/CD integration, requirements analysis, quality strategy, cross‑team collaboration, and root‑cause debugging.
My mission: build smarter tests, accelerate quality, and make engineering teams more effective.
